  (?<sp> (?: \\ \n )*+ )

  (?<items> (?:
      (?&sp) (?:
          # identifier: an encoding prefix (L u U u8) is ordinary identifier text
          [A-Za-z_$\x80-\xff] (?: (?&sp) [\w$\x80-\xff] )*+
          # pp-number: a ' followed by an identifier character is a C23 digit separator
        | (?: \d | \. (?&sp) \d ) (?: (?&sp) (?: [eEpP][+-] | [\w.$\x80-\xff] | ' (?= (?&sp) \w ) ) )*+
          # string and character literals, backslash escapes, a raw newline never inside
        | " (?: [^"\\\n]++ | \\ \n | \\ (?&sp) [^\n] )*+ "
        | ' (?: [^'\\\n]++ | \\ \n | \\ (?&sp) [^\n] )*+ '
          # block comment, line comment (a spliced newline continues it)

        | [^\w$\x80-\xff"'/{}<%] | / (?! (?&sp) [*/] ) | < (?! (?&sp) % ) | % (?! (?&sp) > )

  )*+ )

subbench.objective: Realistic patterns whose feature is outside the common regex subset -- recursion, callouts, caller variables: the answer, the capability verdict (native / assisted / not-capable), and the cost of the feature, assist included.

testee.build_flags: distribution libpcre2-8.so.0 (10.46 2025-08-27), loaded with dlopen; driver built with $CC -O2 -std=gnu11; LIMITS ARM deep (lim-ceil1g, [B148] L4, unusual_set_v1.md 6.2): one match context built before any timed call -- pcre2_set_heap_limit(1048576 KiB), match and depth limits UINT32_MAX, and under JIT a pcre2_jit_stack_create(32 KiB, 1 GiB) stack assigned; the matching instrument timed.c is reached through timed_ctx.c's forwarder (one extra direct call per match), the call stream through timed_calls.c
testee.compile_cost_definition: eager JIT (requirements 3): the explicit compile calls, timed in-driver -- pcre2_compile_8 (`compile`) then pcre2_jit_compile_8(PCRE2_JIT_COMPLETE) (`jit-compile`). Median of N with spread is the REPORTER's reduction.

callees_sha256.description: identity of the shared callee object (unusual_set_v1.md 3.2); ABSENT on a unity build, which recompiles callees.c
callees_sha256.source: pcrecbench/callees.py: sha256 of the ONE callees.o every native-callout driver links (fixed flags, built once)

callout_arm.description: real | pass | twin | pass-nofn: which callout arm this row is

callout_fires.description: callee calls for ONE iteration of this row's operation; absent where the engine has no counting build
callout_fires.source: the untimed COUNTING build (-DUB_COUNT), one fresh process per subject, iters 1 (unusual_set_v1.md 3.2 calibration item 1)

callout_spec.description: the binding spec the driver bound (site=callee,...); `none` for pass-nofn (no callout function at all)
callout_spec.source: the set's [callouts] table, member paths relative to the set

callout_views_sha256.description: the MULTISET of views the callee was shown (pos, group 1, verdict): compared across engines, differences reported
callout_views_sha256.source: the counting build's fire log, its lines SORTED then hashed

capturecount.description: lexical capturing groups in the pattern

compiled_size_bytes.description: size of the compiled pattern block -- requirements 4.2's 'program size' for this engine

deep_maxrss_kb.description: the high-water pass process's peak RSS (KiB): a LIBRARY testee's maxrss (X38 keeps match.process for process testees)
deep_maxrss_kb.source: getrusage(RUSAGE_SELF).ru_maxrss of the fresh untimed process

deep_mem_bytes.description: matcher working-storage high-water in bytes, by `deep_mem_method`; never ranked across methods

jit_size_bytes.description: size of the JIT-compiled machine code; absent on the interpreter testee (an ABSENT pair is not an error, an UNDECLARED one is)

lim_config_depth.description: the library's default depth limit (read back)

lim_config_heap_kib.description: the library's default heap limit, KiB (read back)

lim_config_match.description: the library's default match limit (read back)

lim_depth.source: default arm: = lim_config_depth; deep: pcre2_set_depth_limit(UINT32_MAX) as set

lim_heap_kib.description: the effective heap limit, KiB (interpreter only)
lim_heap_kib.source: default arm: = lim_config_heap_kib; deep: pcre2_set_heap_limit(1048576) as set

lim_jit_stack_bytes.description: the JIT stack's maximum size, bytes
lim_jit_stack_bytes.source: default arm: pcre2jit(3)'s documented 32 KiB machine stack (no getter); deep: pcre2_jit_stack_create(32 KiB, 1 GiB) as set

lim_match.description: the effective match limit (applies to JIT too, E-4)
lim_match.source: default arm: = lim_config_match; deep: pcre2_set_match_limit(UINT32_MAX) as set

lim_pattern_depth.description: a (*LIMIT_DEPTH=) in the pattern; absent when unset

lim_pattern_heap_kib.description: a (*LIMIT_HEAP=) in the pattern, KiB; absent when unset

lim_pattern_match.description: a (*LIMIT_MATCH=) in the pattern; absent when unset

stream_anchor.description: how each call of a call stream is bounded to its segment: `native` = the pattern's own \G at the start offset (the O(segment) pre-flight found no tail dependence), `explicit` = the engine's runtime anchoring option
stream_anchor.source: the adapter: `--anchor-explicit` passed to the driver or not
